Common structural land-cover preference affects urban/rural comparison; no uncertainty interval or significance claim.

recommendation.reason: Smallest cross-media official 2023 district-quality summary: all27 valid same-definition observations, nonconstant spread, coherent direction and documented common monitoring framework. Admit only this published administrative construct, not its components or population exposure claims.
